entities.label: Character
entities.description: A person or personified being — a fictional character, a historical figure, an author, or a real individual named in the text.

properties.name: aliases
properties.description: Other names, titles, or epithets used for this person.

properties.name: role
properties.description: Their role or occupation (e.g. narrator, doctor, king).

properties.name: gender
properties.description: Gender if stated or clearly implied.

entities.label: Location
entities.description: A named place: country, region, city, building, or natural feature.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Type of place: country, city, region, building, natural feature, etc.

entities.label: Organization
entities.description: A named group, institution, society, company, family line, or faction.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Type of organisation: society, company, family, government, etc.

entities.label: Work
entities.description: A named creative or scholarly work: book, poem, play, essay, or publication referenced in the text.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Type of work: novel, poem, play, essay, treatise, etc.

properties.name: author
properties.description: Named author of the work, if given.

entities.label: Object
entities.description: A notable physical object, artifact, substance, or material referred to in the text.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Category of the object or substance.

entities.label: Event
entities.description: A discrete happening, action, or episode in the narrative (journey, battle, death, discovery, ceremony).

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Type of event: journey, battle, death, discovery, meeting, etc.

properties.name: time
properties.description: When it occurred, as stated in the text.

entities.label: Concept
entities.description: An abstract idea, theme, belief, scientific principle, or topic discussed in the text.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Category of the concept: theme, scientific principle, belief, topic, etc.

entities.label: TimePeriod
entities.description: A named point or span of time: a date, year, era, season, or historical period.

relations.label: INTERACTS_WITH
relations.description: One character speaks to, meets, or otherwise interacts with another.

relations.label: FAMILY_OF
relations.description: A family or kinship tie between two characters.

relations.label: MEMBER_OF
relations.description: A character belongs to an organisation, group, or family line.

relations.label: LOCATED_IN
relations.description: A character, organisation, or event is situated in a location.

relations.label: TRAVELS_TO
relations.description: A character moves or journeys to a location.

relations.label: PART_OF
relations.description: A location or organisation is a part of a larger one.

relations.label: PARTICIPATES_IN
relations.description: A character takes part in an event.

relations.label: OWNS
relations.description: A character owns or possesses an object.

relations.label: ASSOCIATED_WITH
relations.description: A character or work is associated with a concept or theme.

relations.label: CAUSES
relations.description: One event causes or leads to another.

relations.label: PRECEDES
relations.description: One event happens before another in time.

relations.label: OCCURS_DURING
relations.description: An event takes place during a named time period.
